paper.title: Neural Network Backflow with Low-Rank Multi-Determinant Updates
paper.authors: Tianshu Huang, Xiaowei Ou, Vidvuds Ozolins

results.system_description: 16x4 rectangular lattice (Lx = 16, Ly = 4), periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.variant: Deep BF with low-rank multi-determinant updates
results.source_location: p. 6, text ('On the largest 4×16 lattice, the Deep BF model achieves an energy of -0.7598 per site')
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the deep backflow state; periodic boundary conditions in both directions are stated in Sec. III.
